challenge.better_approach: Looked: reuse before build. Seals go only through reseal.reseal_all, tickets only through cast_ticket, questions only through cairn question, timing only through the scheduler; each piece adds one reader or one verb on those doors.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a dependent's seal evidence.reached names the components it reached (ticket 734b22d09f2e), so yellow and its dependents are readable from seals alone; and that the base shim's pulse runs on every device that has a list.
challenge.prior_art: Consulted the tickets corpus and the inspector: 50e0581737e8 (dependent-side yellow), the reseal ladder 4d9115eb04cd (rung 3 troubles, rung 4 decisions), 39eccfbc09aa (every sieve carries its why), ddc5cb6694d3 and eb27604ab267 (NOTRUN seals nothing). None does this piece; each is reused.
challenge.real_collision: None exclusive: the bounds of 93fa3e3a6199 and its children also touch build_inspector, recorded as an ordering note, not a collision.

answers.falsifier: (1) adjudicate on a red ticket opens one question bound to it and answers it with exactly one of code-wrong or tooth-wrong, the reasons naming a why or a CP. (2) an inference answer that is neither outcome is refused loudly and no answer is written. (3) a reseal of a proof whose teeth changed passes rung 4 citing that answered question's id.
answers.from_idea: none, because outline 9.4.2.3.7 in press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt (Akien 2026-11-13, at commit 198f4ef24) is the design these tickets carry
answers.how: adjudicate.py in codemother gathers the component charter's why, the tooth's why (the proof's docstring and PROVES text), core-values.md and the run record; asks inferenceproxy over the bus; opens a question on the red ticket and answers it with --measured, so a tooth change can cite the answer as its decision.
answers.traces_to: outline 9.4.2.3.7.6 and 17.11.6/17.11.6.1 (adjudicated by CC against the sieve's own why, never a question to Akien); CP1-CP6; Law 8
answers.what: CodeMother answers an adjudicate verb: an LLM reads a red ticket's proof and code against the component's why, the tooth's why and CP1-CP6, and records code-wrong or tooth-wrong as an answered question on that ticket.

bullets.text: a red ticket is adjudicated against the component's why, the tooth's why and CP1-CP6: one piece of outline 9.4.2.3.7, cast with its siblings

title: CodeMother answers an adjudicate verb: an LLM reads a red ticket's proof and code against the component's why, the tooth
